subject: general
question: What is the primary purpose of preventive maintenance?

options.text: To delay repairs until breakdowns occur
To increase the workload of employees
To eliminate the need for regular inspections

solution:
The correct answer is __To reduce unexpected equipment failures.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Preventive maintenance__ involves regular and planned maintenance activities.
 
• It aims to reduce the risk of unexpected failures and extend the life of equipment.
 
• By identifying potential issues early, preventive maintenance minimizes costly breakdowns and downtime.
 
• It ensures that equipment operates efficiently and safely.
 
• Preventive maintenance is a proactive approach that helps in maintaining operational productivity.
 
• It includes tasks like inspections, cleaning, lubrication, and replacing worn-out parts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Corrective Maintenance:**

 
 
• Corrective maintenance occurs after a breakdown or issue is identified.
 
• It focuses on repairing or restoring equipment to working condition.
 
 
 
• **Predictive Maintenance:**
 
 
• Predictive maintenance uses data and monitoring tools to predict potential failures.
 
• It allows for maintenance actions to be performed just before a failure occurs.
